deviations.from: Work order: a MISCON slot also names its misconception_entry as a field on the item.
deviations.to: The entry id is carried inside the item's provenance string (e.g. 'Misconception entry: MC-9702-7-01') because the v0.2.0 learning_items schema forbids additional properties and has no misconception_entry field.
deviations.why: The schema (standard/v0.2.0-draft/schemas/learning_items.schema.json) fails C-00 on any field it does not declare, so the entry name is preserved where the schema allows it.
